2026-11-10.patch_summary: This patch series fixes issues related to delegated timestamps in the NFS server, specifically problems that were identified by agentic review and additional issues found through testing. The patches address various scenarios where delegated timestamps could be incorrectly updated or not honored, including when change and size match, during DELEGRETURN, and after a size-changing SETATTR operation. The approach taken involves updating several functions in the NFS server code to correctly record and apply delegated timestamps, as well as adding new checks to prevent incorrect updates. Overall, this patch series aims to ensure that delegated timestamps are accurately reflected on the server-side, which is essential for maintaining data consistency and integrity.
